minimal_adapter_patch.name: ArithmeticSchedulerAdapterV1
steps: Receive SourceExecutionContextV1 from the runtime; never accept a bare prime or legacy parent descriptor.
Run a registered branch-specific arithmetic scheduler against source.raw_state and return only TerminalDraftV1, GuardMissV1 or an authority-free CandidateTransitionV1 witness.
Register a BranchRegistrationV1 with source/target owners, evidence refs, source/target terminal schedules, projector and independent validator.
Project canonical integer output to TargetProjectionV1; recompute facts, mark and T5 descriptor without importing legacy owner/family labels.
Let the existing runtime perform target terminal priority, E1-E4 validation, owner classification, T5 ticket verification and the sole queue append.
Add one negative control proving that the original legacy receipt and a forged authority field are rejected before queue mutation.
not_allowed: converting e1_e5 booleans directly into TransitionValidationV1
copying recursive_edge_eligible or persistent_queue into a candidate
using a legacy family/owner label as target classification
reconstructing the source from a fixture or prime

decision: Current PersistentSelectorRuntimeV1 cannot safely ingest any existing F2/F3 arithmetic scheduler directly. The adapter proposal is the smallest safe bridge; until its source receipt, terminal schedule, projector, independent validator and target re-entry are supplied, all such outputs remain analysis evidence or unadmitted conditional candidates.
